texts.preamble: K.Latheefa Beevi vs The State Of Kerala on 2 February, 2010 Author: C.T. Ravikumar Bench: C.T.Ravikumar In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam WP(C).No. 2655 of 2010(F) 1. K.Latheefa Beevi, Other Attender, ... Petitioner Vs 1. The State Of Kerala, Represented By ... Respondent 2. The Director Of Health Services, 3. The Commissioner Of Food Safety, 4. Anil Kumar, For Petitioner :Sri.T.M.Abdul Latheef For Respondent : No Appearance The Hon'ble Mr. Justice C.T.Ravikumar Dated :02/02/2010 O R D E R C.T. Ravikumar, J. -------------------------------------------- W.P.(C) No. 2655 Of 2010 -------------------------------------------- Dated this the 2nd day of February, 2010 Judgment
texts.facts: The petitioner is working as Other Attender in the Health and Family Welfare Department. She is occupying Quarter No.4 attached to the said Department. Earlier, the second respondent had issued an order directing the petitioner to vacate the quarters for the reason that it was allotted to the 4th respondent. That order was challenged by the petitioner in O.S.1510 of 2002 before the Additional Munsiff's Court, Thiruvananthapuram. The said Original Suit was dismissed. Against the said judgment, the petitioner filed A.S. No.223 of 2004 before the District Court, which was also dismissed. Against the judgment in A.S. No.223 of 2004, the petitioner preferred R.S.A. No.1042 of 2009 before this Court and this Court, as per Ext.P2 judgment dismissed the Second Appeal. Learned counsel requested that appellant may be granted breathing time to vacate the quarter. After its formation, the Government passed orders earmarking certain areas in the premises of the Kerala State Health and Family Welfare Institute, Thycaud for the establishment of the Commissionerate. As a result of the said earmarking of areas, Quarter No.4 occupied by the petitioner was also allotted for the said purpose. Aggrieved by the said order in allotting the quarters occupied by the petitioner for the aforesaid purpose, this Writ Petition is filed. 3. The petitioner is challenging Ext.P7 order whereby she was directed to vacate Quarter No.4. According to her, the 4th respondent is instrumental for such a decision. But, it is a fact that the decision to allot the premises of the Kerala State Health and Family Welfare Institute, Thycaud for the establishment of the Commissionerate was taken by the Secretary to Government and, therefore, I am unable to uphold the said contention of the petitioner. The petitioner submits that she had filed Ext.P8 representation dated 15.1.2010 before the authorities in this regard.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has already filed such a representation before the first respondent.
